tagline: Pusat Ibadah, Ukhuwah & Kebajikan Komuniti Pangsapuri Kita Sejati Cybersouth

theme.notes: Presets: teal-amber, emerald-gold, royal-blue, maroon-gold, custom

khairat.coverageNoteMs: Merangkumi ahli berdaftar, pasangan dan anak-anak tanggungan di bawah umur 21 tahun.
khairat.coverageNoteEn: Covers registered member, spouse and dependent children under 21 years old.

benefits.descMs: Khidmat pemandian, kafan, solat jenazah dan pengurusan kubur yang sempurna mengikut syariat.
benefits.descEn: Complete bathing, shrouding, funeral prayer and burial management according to Islamic rites.

benefits.descMs: Kemudahan van jenazah dari hospital atau kediaman ke tanah perkuburan Islam.
benefits.descEn: Hearse transport service from hospital or residence to the Islamic cemetery.

benefits.descMs: Kos penggalian liang lahat, batu nisan asas dan urusan tapak tanah perkuburan.
benefits.descEn: Grave excavation, basic tombstone and cemetery management fees covered.

benefits.descMs: Bantuan kewangan segera kepada waris terdekat bagi meringankan beban keluarga.
benefits.descEn: Immediate monetary assistance to immediate family to ease unexpected expenses.

blog.descMs: Perkongsian ilmu, takwim kuliah, aktiviti komuniti dan panduan kariah.
blog.descEn: Knowledge sharing, lecture schedules, community events and guidance.
